entries.7c8d8de454c4cb8c: A company that operates a variety of game-related businesses, centered on the game strategy information media "GameWith," including the operation of esports teams and fiber-optic internet for gamers.
entries.924adf39f851d0fa: This business focuses on operating the esports team "DetonatioN FocusMe". In addition to tournament prize money, it earns revenue from sponsorship, event hosting, and support payments from esports title publishers, and it also conducts fan business, including selling goods and distributing videos to fans of players and teams. It also provides creator management for game streaming video creators and similar. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,162 million.
entries.9fdc2cdec31648f9: This is a business not included in reportable segments, mainly developing NFT business. It has been commissioned to carry out promotion and similar work for EGGRYPTO, an NFT game by Kyuzan Inc., an investee, and it operates the NFT game specialist media "GameWith NFT". Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥140 million.
entries.b69342730a76efd7: This business provides the "GameWith Hikari" high-speed, low-latency optical fiber internet service. The service is provided through the joint venture GameWith ARTERIA Inc., and the number of subscribers is growing steadily. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥431 million.
